paragraphs: MedSuite sells EMR and RCM software to human and behavioral health providers. The stated purpose of that ecosystem is to help clinicians be more effective and efficient and to improve patient care. Product offerings are grouped as RCM Software & Services, EHR & EMR, Practice Management and Case Management.

The RCM line is described as helping healthcare providers maximize reimbursement and improve cash flow. Practice management software is presented as covering government compliance and private payer requirements. Case management covers service planning for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

The company puts its brands' combined experience at 168 years and says products are used by thousands of clinicians. The homepage lists Brittco, Electrobills, EMR-Bear, Millin and Susquehanna as brands in the portfolio.

quote.text: Serving behavioral health systems with a comprehensive portfolio of technology solutions.
